name: Pine Crafter Furniture
old_description: Discover timeless craftsmanship and quality at Pine Crafter Furniture. As a family owned and operated furniture manufacturing company since 1983, we specialize in bunk beds, captain beds, case goods, and more. Explore our exquisite collection today!
about:
Pine Crafter Furniture has been a family-owned and operated manufacturer in Haleyville, Alabama since 1983. The company was founded as a furniture manufacturing business specializing in solid pine wood products, though the names of the original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces bunk beds, captain beds, case goods, and related bedroom furniture, with a focus on solid pine wood construction. Its product range includes children’s bunk beds, adult bunk beds, staircase bunk beds, conversion kits, underbed storage units, and desk-and-chair sets. Operations have historically included both domestic and Brazilian-sourced lines, though the domestic line is being discontinued and Brazilian inventory is being cleared. The firm is now shifting its focus to the Furniture Dash product line, with new bunk bed styles and collections planned.

Pine Crafter sells through furniture stores and distributors across the United States, serving the residential furniture retail and wholesale channels. Its customer base includes independent furniture retailers and larger distributors who stock the company’s bunk beds and case goods.

The company emphasizes quality, affordability, and prompt delivery as its distinguishing attributes, positioning itself as a leading provider of solid pine wood bunk beds in the U.S. market. The transition to the Furniture Dash line reflects an effort to refresh the product portfolio while maintaining the family-owned operational ethos.
